name: modelhub-vscode
description: AI model and API management hub for VS Code

viewsWelcome.contents:
ModelHub is active.
No providers are registered yet.
[Refresh](command:modelhub.refresh)

modelhub.general.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the ModelHub output channel.

modelhub.providers.enableAutoDiscovery.description: Reserved for a future phase: automatic model discovery for providers.

modelhub.agent.enabled.description: Reserved for a future phase: enables the ModelHub agent runtime.

modelhub.permissions.defaultLevel.description: Default permission level applied by the permission/policy engine (independent of the selected AI model).

modelhub.memory.autoCapture.description: Reserved for a future phase: automatic memory capture under ~/.modelhub/memory (local-only by default).

modelhub.backend.baseUrl.description: Reserved for a future phase: URL of the shared ModelHub backend. Empty means fully local/offline.

modelhub.terminal.allowExecution.description: Reserved for a future phase: allows agent tool execution in the integrated terminal (goes through the permission engine).

modelhub.recovery.snapshotOnSave.description: Reserved for a future phase: creates recovery snapshots before agent file modifications.
